new_today_news.headline: Why Seattle Restaurant Owners Should Deep Clean Grease Traps Monthly
new_today_news.summary: Article discusses how Seattle restaurant owners face health code violations, emergency repairs, and potential closure from neglected grease trap maintenance. Emphasizes that Seattle's health department takes grease violations seriously.

recent_news.headline: WaterBridge Infrastructure Acquires Northern Delaware Basin Landfill Environmental Waste Management Facility
recent_news.summary: WaterBridge Infrastructure entered into a purchase agreement to acquire an environmental waste management facility in Lea County, New Mexico for approximately $189 million ($169 million net after selling 560 acres to LandBridge). The facility acquisition supports WaterBridge's expansion of its waste management business.

recent_news.headline: Cities Look to the Future on Water Infrastructure Funding and Programs
recent_news.summary: The IIJA allocates $50 billion over five years for water infrastructure, divided across Clean Water and Drinking Water State Revolving Funds. Highlights concerns about reauthorization challenges and notes that IIJA funding expires on September 30, 2026, leaving states facing significant reductions in assistance.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Q2 2026 Earnings Beat; Strong Fats, Proteins, and Diamond Green Diesel Performance
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q2 2026 net income of $387.3M ($2.41/share), driven by higher fats and proteins prices and strong Diamond Green Diesel performance. The company guides for Q3 2026 core ingredients Adjusted EBITDA of $325–340M and expects net debt below $3B by year-end.

backfill_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Q2 2026: Net Income Jumps to $387.3M, EPS $2.41 Beats; Margin Expansion Driven by Rendering Feedstocks
backfill_news.summary: Darling Ingredients' Q2 2026 results showed net income of $387.3M with sales of $1.7B and combined adjusted EBITDA of $741.7M, triple prior-year levels. The company narrowed leverage to 2.3X and signaled strong momentum into 2027.

backfill_news.headline: GFL Environmental Q2 2026 Earnings; Organic Growth 6.4%, Pricing +7% Sequential, SECURE Transaction Pending
backfill_news.summary: GFL Environmental's second-quarter revenue increased 16.3% from the prior year, including 6.4% organic growth. The company raised full-year 2026 guidance and noted the pending SECURE transaction could exceed 20% adjusted EBITDA growth if closed in Q4.
